title: SB305 (2021 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2021/bills/SB305_.HTM; sha256 ae7aae89d05eef025d359842144f3c5a249bbe6daf70cb680c2bdf669bf1ea3c)
provenance.note: Introduced version as filed (same text in 2021). Subsection (c), not quoted because it runs across struck text, strikes the fifteen-day no-permit loan and the 75-day out-of-State loan, and limits loans of a rifle or shotgun to an adult 21 or older to twelve hours, with the borrower holding a permit or owning a registered firearm.

operative_text: SECTION 2 (HRS 134-4): No person shall knowingly lend a firearm to any person who does not have a permit pursuant to section 134-2, does not own or possess a firearm that is registered pursuant to section 134-3, or is prohibited from ownership or possession of a firearm under section 134-7.
